note: GD-06, seal immutability. This file is the record of what is under data/sealed/. The guard recomputes the record from the directory and fails if the two disagree in either direction: a file that is not listed, a listed file that is gone, or a listed file whose bytes changed. It is empty because nothing has been sealed. Phase 11 writes the entries at the seal event and docs/prereg/SEAL.md records the same event in prose.
